provenance.notes: City ids are the numeric ids preserved by pikud-haoref-api, which builds this cache from Pikud HaOref GetDistricts / segment polygon ids. Those official URLs returned HTTP 403 to the environment that committed this file, so the ids were not re-confirmed against a live response. District ids are assigned by oref-alerts-core from the Hebrew zone string.
